items.text: I quite enjoyed the previous game Neo Scavenger. OstraNauts tries to be bigger and on a first glance the game has great vibes and I am sure somewhere there is good game in this. However in its current state there are just too many bugs. Also "watch progress bar" is not a very fun game mechanic..
items.text_zh: 我相当喜欢之前的游戏《Neo Scavenger》。OstraNauts试图做得更大，乍一看这游戏氛围很棒，我相信其中某处藏着一款好游戏。然而在目前的状态下，bug实在太多了。而且“盯着进度条”并不是一个很有趣的游戏机制。

observations.description: 观看进度条不是有趣的游戏机制
observations.evidence: "watch progress bar" is not a very fun game mechanic
observations.evidence_zh: “盯着进度条看”并不是一种很有趣的游戏机制
